SELECT CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC

SELECT CAST(r.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, r.room_name AS roomName, CASE WHEN r.clean_status = 'dirty' THEN 1 WHEN r.clean_status = 'clean' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS isDirty, CASE WHEN r.lock_status = 'offline' THEN 0 WHEN r.lock_status IS NULL OR r.lock_status = '' THEN NULL ELSE 1 END AS isCanBooking, CAST(r.floor_id AS CHAR) AS floorId, rf.floor_name AS floorName, 0 AS seq, r.lock_status AS lockStatus, r.sale_type AS saleType, r.clean_status AS cleanStatus FROM room r JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = r.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_floor rf ON rf.floor_id = r.floor_id AND rf.is_deleted = 0 AND rf.status = 1 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0
AND (r.sale_type IS NULL OR r.sale_type != 'hourly')
AND r.sale_type = 'hourly'
ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC, r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC
